cleanPlatePrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE clean static background plate from the supplied approved Japanese woodblock weather card, for layered animation. Remove ONLY the moving airborne precipitation: every falling rain streak, drifting snowflake, sleet pellet, hailstone in flight, and every lightning bolt. Repair their former pixels naturally with the same paper grain and flat printed colors. Preserve the exact composition and weather setting, cloud shapes and coverage, fog and mist, day/night lighting, sun or moon, sea waves, rippled water, ground puddles, architecture, trees and mountain silhouettes in their existing positions. Preserve all existing settled snow on roofs/trees/ground, ice glaze, icicles, frost, slush and hail pellets already resting on the ground. In mixed precipitation remove all airborne types. For scattered or isolated showers keep the localized shower-cloud shapes and clear gaps, just remove the falling marks beneath them. Do not turn the scene sunny or clear. Do not add objects or change colors, proportions, scene details or crop. Tall narrow 4:9 full-bleed image, same as input, no text or borders. The output is one static clean plate; animation overlays will be composited separately from single-frame PNGs.
